statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-9079: when an application told libcurl to clear its proxy credentials, libcurl did not clear them, so the old proxy username and password could be used for later transfers that should not use them (https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-9079.html). It affects libcurl from 8.8.0 to 8.20.0 (not the curl tool) and was fixed in curl 8.21.0 by https://github.com/curl/curl/commit/88c7e16cceec816a2df45c899d49b1e85513f193. The DHI curl packages for Alpine 3.23 are builds of curl 8.17.0-r1, 8.18.0-r0 (in both the main and the security repository), 8.19.0-r0, 8.20.0-r0, 8.20.0-r1, 8.21.0-r0, 8.22.0-r0, 8.23.0-r0 and 8.23.0-r1, and the version string in each build's libcurl matches its package version. Every build before 8.21.0-r0 is a curl release in the affected range, and 8.21.0-r0 is the first build of curl 8.21.0, so it is the first fixed build.
